note: Stage 4: addition and multiplication are two ways of reading the same things. Four groups of three become four times three, then two times five splits into five plus five. Quiz: listen to the repeated addition and pick the times sentence / link sums to times sentences / find the pair that does not match.

lines.text: Look! Four groups of three. That is twelve.
Three plus three plus three plus three equals four times three!
Two times five. That means two groups of five.
Two plus two plus two plus two plus two.
Three plus three plus three plus three.
Link each sum to its times sentence.
Find the pair that does not match.
